privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Maps, your privacy is our core value. Maps is designed as a local-first, client-side application. We do not operate server infrastructure to collect, store, track, or sell your personal details or saved place markers.
privacy.section1_text: All place markers, names, descriptions, and custom categories you record are stored locally on your device in a sandboxed PouchDB database. This data is private to your browser. Clearing your browser's application cache or using incognito/private modes will remove this database.
privacy.section2_text1: If you choose to enable cloud synchronization, Maps links directly to the secure cloud APIs provided by Filen. Your credentials (email, password, and two-factor code) are processed purely on the client side to retrieve security keys directly from Filen.
privacy.section2_text2: Your saved places are compiled and encrypted client-side using military-grade AES-256-GCM encryption before leaving your device, then stored as a private file named places.json inside a folder named maps. We do not have access to your decryption keys, password, or plaintext places.
privacy.section3_text: We do not collect diagnostics, crash logs, IP address tracking, telemetry, or user analytics. The application operates in complete anonymity.
privacy.section4_text: Because this project is open-source and AGPL-3.0 licensed, you can review the source code directly, run your own builds, or contribute adjustments openly on the repository.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Maps. By accessing or using our application, you agree to bound by these terms. Please read them carefully before using our software.
terms.section1_text: Maps is provided free of charge for personal and non-commercial exploration. You agree not to misuse our service, attempt unauthorized access to third-party APIs, or exceed usage rate limits.
terms.section2_text: Maps relies on open geographic datasets (including OpenStreetMap and OpenFreeMap) and third-party cloud synchronization (Filen). We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or accuracy of third-party map data or APIs.
